_comment: NUIG Alice Perry Building AHU101 (serves Lecture Theatre 3, room G047) point -> CAMBER Role mapping. Dataset: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.3406555 (CDLA-Permissive-1.0), one headerless 'timestamp,value' file per point inside nuig-data.tar.gz; the raw column names here are the files' own point ids. The unit is a 100% OUTDOOR-AIR unit with a thermal wheel (the BMS graphic in the variables workbook shows no mixing box, no dampers and no mixed-air sensor), then a frost (pre-heat) coil, a cooling coil and a post-heat coil, with fixed-step supply / extract fans (0, 40 or 60%). So: NO mixed_air_temp and no oa_damper -- the frost-coil leaving temperature (TE_101_1) is NOT a mixed-air temperature and mapping it as one would make outdoor_air_fraction and leaking_valve compute nonsense; they decline instead. heat_valve is the POST-heat valve (TCV_101_1); the frost-coil valve (TCV_101_3) has no role. HS_101_1 (SAF enable) matches SAF speed > 0 in all but 4 of 559,857 minutes, so it is mapped as fan status here (unlike the LBNL enables). co2 is the room AVERAGE (starts 2018-04-10); the two room sensors (CO_147_1/_2) are unmapped. TE_102_2 ('air after cooling coil') is unmapped: see the nuig-ahu101 data issue. All temperatures are degC in the source (converted at ingest).
